sections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
sections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress? Prana is a premium medium soft mattress combining 100% natural latex with 3-zone pocket springs for ultimate comfort. It is part of Duroflex's Natural Living range, and features a 100% natural pin core latex layer paired with individually wrapped pocket springs, wrapped in luxe fabric infused with organic cotton. 2. What problem does Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress solve? It addresses multiple sleep concerns: partner disturbance, heat retention, allergen sensitivity (100% natural latex is hypoallergenic), and the need for responsive bounce combined with body support. 3. Who is Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress best for? Perfect for couples seeking zero motion transfer, buyers prioritizing sustainable materials, hot sleepers needing natural cooling, individuals with allergies, and anyone wanting premium comfort combining spring bounce with 100% natural latex support. 4. How does Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress work? The mattress features a 100% natural pin core latex layer (with small holes for air circulation) paired with 3-zone individually wrapped pocket springs. Each spring responds independently to your body's pressure, providing personalized support while preventing motion transfer; when one partner moves, the springs contain that movement locally. The organic cotton-infused fabric keeps the surface cool and fresh. 5. How is Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress different from alternatives? Unlike competitors, Prana combines 100% natural latex with 3-zone pocket spring technology and organic cotton fabric. Prana uses pure natural latex. The zero motion transfer capability combined with natural cooling sets it apart from all-latex alternatives. The 3-zone pocket spring layer focuses specifically on couples' comfort and natural support. 6. How does Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress feel Medium soft — Feels plush and bouncy with 100% natural latex's responsive support. The pocket springs deliver noticeable bounce, making position changes easy, while maintaining comfortable support. 7. Does Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress come with a warranty? Yes, it comes with 10-year conditional warranty and also includes 10-day replacement guarantee. 8. How to care for Prana Pocket Spring Latex Mattress? Always use a mattress protector to protect against dust, spills, and allergens, and get it professionally deep-cleaned twice a year for better hygiene. Do not flip or turn the mattress, avoid ironing on it, and never fold or bend it as it may damage the mattress structure.
